verdict.rationale: Stripe documents open, published protocols: ACP is an Apache-2.0 specification, MPP has its spec published at mpp.dev, and the custom ACP integration defines request and response shapes. For MPP it also ships a conformance CLI, `mppx validate`, which tests discovery, challenge formats, error handling and the full payment flow. Missing for 10: explicit protocol versioning (only the mppx SDK package version is shown), a machine-readable schema (OpenAPI probes returned 404), validation tooling for ACP/UCP checkout, and independent hands-on corroboration of the validator.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build against a versioned commerce protocol with a published schema and conformance or validation tooling

citations.quote: Run `mppx validate` to automatically verify your implementation end-to-end. The command tests discovery, challenge formats, error handling, and the full payment flow.
ACP is open source and community-designed under the Apache 2.0 license. Businesses can implement the specification to transact with any AI agent or payment processor.
the Machine Payments Protocol is published in the open — https://mpp.dev/ answers a plain GET with the full markdown spec index
implement a reverse API that defines the requests Stripe sends to your commerce backend and the response shapes your backend returns
